blocks.html: This method adds prices to a price set.

types.name: data
types.description: The data defining the price set to add the prices to, along with the prices to add.

children.name: priceSetId
children.description: The ID of the price set to add prices to.

children.name: prices
children.description: The prices to add to the price set.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the money amount.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of this money amount.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount of this money amount.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity required to be purchased for this money amount to be applied.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity required to be purchased for this money amount to be applied.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules to add to the price. The object's keys are the attribute, and values are the value of that rule associated with this price.

types.name: sharedContext
types.description: A context used to share resources, such as transaction manager, between the application and the module.

children.name: transactionManager
children.description: An instance of a transaction manager of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `transactionManager`.

children.name: manager
children.description: An instance of a manager, typically an entity manager, of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `manager`.

children.name: isolationLevel
children.description: A string indicating the isolation level of the context. Possible values are `READ UNCOMMITTED`, `READ COMMITTED`, `REPEATABLE READ`, or `SERIALIZABLE`.

children.name: enableNestedTransactions
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether nested transactions are enabled.

children.name: eventGroupId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the group to aggregate the events to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: transactionId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current transaction.

children.name: runId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current run.

children.name: messageAggregator
children.description: An instance of a message aggregator, which is used to aggregate messages to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: requestId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current request.

children.name: idempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the current workflow execution.

children.name: parentStepIdempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the parent workflow execution.

children.name: preventReleaseEvents
children.description: preventReleaseEvents

children.name: isCancelling
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether the current workflow execution is being cancelled.

children.name: cancelingFromParentStep
children.description:
Weither or not a sub workflow cancellation is being triggered from a parent step.
If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.

types.name: addPrices
types.description: This method adds prices to a price set.
types.example: To add a default price to a price set, don't pass it any rules and make sure to pass it the`currency_code`:const priceSet = await pricingModuleService.addPrices({ priceSetId: "pset_123", prices: [ { amount: 500, currency_code: "USD", rules: {}, }, ], })To add prices with rules:const priceSet = await pricingModuleService.addPrices({ priceSetId: "pset_123", prices: [ { amount: 300, currency_code: "EUR", rules: { region_id: "PL", city: "krakow", }, }, { amount: 400, currency_code: "EUR", min_quantity: 0, max_quantity: 4, rules: { region_id: "PL", }, }, { amount: 450, currency_code: "EUR", rules: { city: "krakow", }, }, ], })

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the price set.

children.name: prices
children.description: The prices that belong to this price set.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the money amount.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of this money amount.

children.name: amount
children.description: The price of this money amount.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity required to be purchased for this price to be applied.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity required to be purchased for this price to be applied.

children.name: rules_count
children.description: The number of rules that apply to this price

children.name: price_rules
children.description: The price rules that apply to this price

children.name: created_at
children.description: When the money\_amount was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: When the money\_amount was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: When the money\_amount was deleted.

children.name: calculated_price
children.description: The calculated price based on the context.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the price set.

children.name: is_calculated_price_price_list
children.description:
Whether the calculated price is associated with a price list. During the calculation process, if no valid price list is found,
the calculated price is set to the original price, which doesn't belong to a price list. In that case, the value of this property is `false`.

children.name: is_calculated_price_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the calculated price is tax inclusive or not.

children.name: calculated_amount
children.description: The amount of the calculated price, or `null` if there isn't a calculated price.

children.name: is_original_price_price_list
children.description:
Whether the original price is associated with a price list. During the calculation process, if the price list of the calculated price is of type override,
the original price will be the same as the calculated price. In that case, the value of this property is `true`.

children.name: is_original_price_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the original price is tax inclusive or not.

children.name: original_amount
children.description: The amount of the original price, or `null` if there isn't a calculated price.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the calculated price, or null if there isn't a calculated price.

children.name: calculated_price
children.description: The details of the calculated price.

children.name: original_price
children.description: The details of the original price.
